scope: Current cross-discipline navigation, discovery/checker contracts, read-only record summaries and frozen task replays. No new discipline-specific content validation is inferred from navigation or software checks.

publication_style.update_identity: Source inventory and SHA-256 content identity

limits: Fictional jurisdictions and source packets only; no real law or real case validation.
The independent reviewer is an AI agent who also reviewed method/source guidance, not a human legal expert or the task executor.
Two cases cover the stated variants only in these supplied settings; they do not establish all-jurisdiction or all-subfield coverage.
Checks of byte identity do not alone establish execution chronology or legal correctness.
legal_tasks.scope: Existing frozen synthetic task executions/reviews, replayed with current software; no new legal-content review or changed outcome.

skill_creator_validation.scope: rw-question scaffold/frontmatter check; all eight discovery entrypoints also checked by the dependency-free full suite.

preservation.scope: Recorded nonruntime personal files only; no claim of a full runtime audit.

hosted_ci.binding: Read the run matching the selected exact commit. Generated dist/release-validation.json records actual archive and hosted-run acceptance separately to avoid self-referential commit/archive identities.

limits: Professional navigation examples do not establish complete coverage or new specialized task validation.
Recorded variant bindings are declarations, not a new execution or renewed scientific review; missing variants remain unspecified.
Existing synthetic tasks and AI-agent content reviews retain their original limited scopes.
Local full suite executed on macOS Python 3.14.6; match the actual commit-specific CI for other environments.
The discovery checker validates a documented safe YAML subset, not every optional host YAML structure.
Directory upgrade retains its documented short reader gap and caught-failure rollback; no power-loss transaction guarantee.

general_audit.reader_review_scope: Independent routing/readability review of observational education and creative-practice requests; not completed research studies.
general_audit.variant_summary: Declares guidance separately from explicit recorded bindings, method-only records and unavailable evaluation material. No inferred binding from task names or new content certification.
checker_fixes: Ambiguous YAML discovery scalars no longer pass as strings.
Duplicate catalog/scenario IDs and invalid method/variant suggestions are reported.
Generated/cache/private-state directories do not cause false source-link/syntax failures.
